synopsis: Volvo CE’s Collision Mitigation System, dated January 2023, requires the Radar Detect System to be fitted; Chapters 2 and 13 consistently repeat this prerequisite [f1383, f10437, f10628]. Chapter 2 describes the collision mitigation system as targeting any obstacle using radar [f1628]. Chapter 13 identifies Radar Detect as separately fitted and draws out the resulting commissioning dependency, but the supplied facts give no installation duration or commissioning schedule [f10807].

relations.note: Both identify the January 2023 system and its Radar Detect prerequisite.
Both state that the Collision Mitigation System requires Radar Detect.
Repeated Radar Detect fitting requirement; one also specifies January 2023.

Makes the commissioning implication of the Radar Detect prerequisite explicit.
